text:
maya: Morning — planning a "daybench" pass for GPU SKUs tonight (A100/H100/L40S). Need volunteers to run baseline + tiny-batch vs reg-batch across seq=512 and seq=2048. Target metrics: p99 latency, tokens/s, and peak GPU mem.

maya: High-level plan:
- run same workload on each SKU in east cluster
- run quantized L40S variant for comparison
- upload csv + flamegraphs to s3://redwood-inference/bench/daybench/2143658700/

maya: Quick config I'm proposing (copyable):
```
./run_bench --model=gpt-j-8b --seq-len=512,2048 --batch-sizes=1,4,8 --profile=flame --warmup=50 --iters=100
```

maya: If anyone can't run but can review results, lmk. Also will add an A/B tag in the console for canary checks.

dylan: I can run A100 and H100 tonight. What timeslot? I can start at 02:00 PT and let overnight runs finish.

samir: I'll take L40S (including quantized build). I'll also run with prefix/KV caching enabled to see cache hit impact.

jen: I'll own result review + PR with the perf notes. Ping me when uploads finish.

bench-bot: run_id=daybench-2143658700-a100 started on pool-east-a100-12 at 2143659200

dylan: started a100 run, attaching logs to s3 once done.

dylan: H100 run queued, ETA ~10m, will chain H100 after A100 completes.

samir: L40S quant build started. Heads-up: if memory > 85% for seq2048, drop batch to 4.

maya: Thanks — reminder: if we see >10% p99 regression on H100 vs A100 baseline, stop any canary rollouts and file an incident ticket. Also annotate any config diffs (driver/kernel) in the upload metadata.

jen: noted. I'll prepare a short checklist for reviewers (p99 delta, troughput delta, mem, kernel/driver mismatch, and ops notes).

bench-bot: run_id=daybench-2143658700-a100 finished (success). artifacts: s3://redwood-inference/bench/daybench/2143658700/a100/

dylan: uploaded a100 results. starting h100 now.

samir: uploaded l40s results (quant + fp16). I included `nvprof` flamegraphs and `nvidia-smi topo`. s3://redwood-inference/bench/daybench/2143658700/l40s/

jen: will start reviewing logs in 30m. If anyone sees an obvious anomaly call it out here with a short note.

maya: awesome. After review let's sync async in this thread with a short summary and next steps (:thumbsup:).
